page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance provisioned on the KVM hypervisor with x86_64 architecture. The server is equipped with 64 dedicated vCPUs backed by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. System memory totals 128.0 GB, establishing a allocation ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU designed for processing workloads.

The hardware configuration includes no bundled local disk storage, necessitating network-attached storage solutions for persistent data needs. Host network connectivity is sustained by a 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth capacity, providing network throughput for server nodes. Public IPv4 addresses are not included complimentary, and no dedicated GPU accelerators are attached to this instance profile.

With a 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio, the system balances CPU processing density against system memory capacity. Qualitatively, this structure provides cost efficiency by eliminating local storage overhead and redundant memory provisioning for CPU-bound infrastructure. Fits include batch processing, software compilation pipelines, web server arrays, and ETL operations.
